risks: No participants; the ethical risk is an endorsement that directs people to unsafe advice.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: age (older adults and children), language and health literacy are reported separately wherever studies allow, because listing an app that serves these groups worse would widen inequities.
effectiveness: Gives the committee an honest basis for its decision.
partnerships: Committee lay members review a draft summary for readability.
rebPath: No research ethics review is needed for a review of published literature; conflicts of interest are declared, and no contact with the companies occurs during the review.
limitations: Single reviewer; rapidly changing apps; little real-user evidence.
summary: No ethics review needed; equity reporting and independence from the companies are the ethical safeguards.
